params.name: steps

default.title: Credit on another key
default.say: A seller on this portal offers credit on their AI key. Buy a pack and their key works for you up to what you paid for, with no daily or monthly limit.

default.title: Before you buy
default.say: This note sets out how the arrangement works. The portal records the credit and raises a bill; you and the seller settle it between yourselves.

default.title: On sale
default.say: Each offer shows the seller, the terms and the rates that set your price. Press Ask to buy, choose a pack or another amount, and the dialog shows the rates before you send.

default.title: Your requests
default.say: Your requests lists every ask with its amount and state. A request waiting for an answer can be withdrawn; once Approved, the Credit column shows what you have left.

default.title: Credit running low
default.say: When credit on a bought key runs low, a card appears at the top with Buy more beside it, so your work continues without a pause.

params.label: The steps in order: title, say (the narration), target (where the spotlight goes; alternatives split by |, the first on screen wins), art (the picture: hero/flow/roads/meter/stack/check), place (below/above/right/left/center, optional), open (optional: what the guide presses first when the part is not on screen - open the first item, go back Home; alternatives split by |)
